concurrency_policy: v15.2 cadence — REVISED 2026-05-20 (user directive: 'every two minutes send out one agent no matter what, for one gold upgrade ... on three if there's still two being worked on it goes to three ... maximum of five ... working on one at a time'). MODEL: a steady drip. Every 2 min the cron launches exactly ONE gold-upgrade agent. Each agent SOLO-does one complete gold-format reformat of ONE distinct library entry, end to end: picks its target, drafts the full gold rewrite with all 10 elements, and POSTs it itself. NO crew, NO draft/finish split, NO block-splitting. Agents ACCUMULATE — agent 1 on gold-upgrade #1; 2 min later agent 2 on a DIFFERENT entry #2; 2 min later agent 3 on #3; and so on. Each agent lasts ~8-12 min then 'falls off' when its entry lands. HARD CAP: 5 gold-upgrade agents in flight at once. At each 2-min tick: COUNT in-flight gold-upgrade agents — if fewer than 5, launch ONE new solo agent on a fresh target; if exactly 5, SKIP the tick. When an upgrade lands a slot frees and the next tick refills it. Steady state ~4-5 in flight. TARGET PICK: each new agent picks the newest eligible entry (qs>=10, format_v != '2026-05', plain q#### id, id below 9501, not in the q1946-q1954 batch, no sales-training tag) that is NOT already being worked by an in-flight agent and not already gold — maintain a skip-list of in-flight + landed ids so two agents never collide on one entry. WORD DISCIPLINE: each agent must compose at the right density the FIRST time — aim 9,300-9,800 words (floor 9,000, cap 10,500; a body over 10,500 returns HTTP 413). Do NOT over-write past 10,500 then trim — over-writing followed by slow micro-trimming is exactly what stalled the prior crew closers (their assembled drafts ballooned to 11,000-14,000w and they could not trim down in time). LIVE-MAP VISIBILITY: the MOMENT an agent is spawned, POST a cron-goldformat 'started' event to pulse-cron-log — {key:'pulsemachine-writer-2026', task:'goldformat', tick:N, ids:['<target q-id>'], summary:'...'}. The ids field is REQUIRED: the live map keys exactly ONE worker per target id and removes it when that entry's gold POST lands. CROSS-LINK FORMAT: cross-links MUST use the (q####) parenthesized format — the entry renderer pulse-machine-entry.js ignores [[q####]] wiki brackets. CRON 29c6c2b2 fires every 2 min and runs this tick. RETIRED: the staggered 2-target 3-wave crew model — superseded by this 1-agent-every-2-min solo model (the crew's block-split coordination caused section overlaps and the closers stalled trimming oversized assembled drafts). QA sweep unchanged (see qa_policy).

qa_policy: User directive 2026-05-20 ('have it on every single answer, but slowly'; 'slow is fine, one every few minutes, just eventually do them all'): QA-audit EVERY gold-format entry — the ~51 already converted AND every future one. Slow background sweep: ~1 QA agent every ~3 minutes (roughly every 3rd cron tick), NOT every minute — the slow pace is intentional. Each QA agent is READ-ONLY (no POST, no deploy): fetch one stored gold entry, audit it against the 10 gold elements + the 9,000-10,500 word count + a substance check (padding / fabricated facts / repetition / broken markdown) + a cross-link RENDER check (the entry renderer pulse-machine-entry.js only linkifies the (q####) parenthesized form, so any [[q####]] wiki-bracket cross-links render as dead plain text — convert every [[q####]] to (q####)), and report PASS / PASS-WITH-NITS / FAIL. Walk oldest-converted-first; track audited ids in qa_audited[]. On a FAIL verdict, FIX the entry — a full re-conversion if badly broken (q102-style: far under the 9,000-word floor / many missing elements), or a targeted SURGICAL PATCH if the defects are localized (q1982-style: a heading-level nit + one contradictory sentence + a couple of off-topic cross-links). FIX->CLOSE (user directive 2026-05-20, 'when it fails, another agent needs to help it fix it and then close it'): the fix agent must SELF-VERIFY all 10 gold elements + the 9,000-word floor before its single POST; once the corrected entry lands and verifies, the entry is CLOSED — recorded as resolved in history. q102 (re-converted 3,121w->9,329w) and q1982 (surgical patch) are both CLOSED. QA agents do NOT count against the gold-agent in-flight cap. KNOWN SUSPECT: q102 landed at only 3,121w (the t200-A 'LITE' failure) — expect FAIL and re-convert it.
